subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make `/v1/chat/completions` tolerate or ignore a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The source path is narrow, but the choice changes public API semantics for model selection and may need parity decisions across Responses and embeddings.

options.title: Decide shared precedence first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one consistent rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings, then implement that rule in the shared Gateway helper.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat a valid agent header as the agent selector and allow generic body model strings as client compatibility metadata for the covered endpoint set.

options.title: Preserve agent-target model requirement
options.body: Keep requiring body `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and document SDK clients to send that value with optional `x-openclaw-model`.

recommendation.title: Decide shared precedence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose one consistent rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings, then implement that rule in the shared Gateway helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant decision is about the agent-first OpenAI-compatible Gateway model contract introduced in vincentkoc's history.
